saw_lines: Lingerie is bought for fit and gifted to partners, so buyers need proof the size will work before they click.
So the sale is won or lost on fit, and the site’s FAQ spends its questions on loyalty credits, not sizing.
Your site offers free shipping over $350 and 261 reviews, two things a first-time buyer checks. Put both in the headline of your Google creatives so new buyers act before the click.
